name: meta-convergence-audit-backlog
title: Fix convergence_check META audit container handling
description: convergence_check currently treats the B-META-framework-audit META container as an unfinished lifecycle story because only DONE and DISCARDED are terminal in the story-completion check. This conflicts with session_brief, where META is an audit/finding container that does not run story_advance. Adjust convergence_check so META is not counted as unfinished story work, and add a separate audit backlog check that only blocks on verified high or critical audit findings. Also resolve the already-fixed B-META-framework-audit:F-004 finding with the B-4c38 merge evidence.
